{{Quote|Abandon ship!|A Mandalorian when their shipped was attacked|<ref name="Chapter 23" />}}
A '''langskib'''<ref name="Highlights">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-23-the-spies-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 23: The Spies"}}</ref> was a type of longship operated in [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> by [[Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian survivors|survivors]] who stayed on [[Mandalore]] after the [[Great Purge of Mandalore]]. It was led by a [[Unidentified Mandalorian captain|Mandalorian captain]]. They were joined by Mandalorians who [[Conflict on Mandalore|retook Mandalore]]. Together they traveled to the [[Great Forge]], but were attacked on the way by a [[trinitaur]] who destroyed the ship. The Mandalorians abandoned the ship and escaped with their [[jetpack]]s.<ref name="Chapter 23" />
